title: A successful final write cannot erase unresolved upstream bench checks
steps: Run chain-bench-verdict.test.mjs sequentially with Node 24. A planner that exhausts its checks twice stops the chain engine, and the same terminal QA predicate used by the demo runner is evaluated on the stopped record.
expect: Planner, copy and picture standing failures produce an explicit failed step.
A planner that fails its checks twice stops the build (ADR 0047): its best content is kept in the stop report, never given to a later step or written, and both attempts' cost is recorded.
A successful final write does not pass QA when upstream checks remain; valid verified fallback behavior is preserved.
fence: Standing failures become a durable chain error code that terminal demo QA must reject

tests: a completed model run with remaining check failures is not a successful chain step
checked planner failures twice stop the build: the best content is reported, never written
final QA rejects unresolved upstream checks while keeping verified fallback semantics
